title: 🔥估值底强于上轮同期
body: 市场处于历史周期筑底期。MVRV 指标报 1.26，尽管仍处于低于历史 77% 时间的低位，但数值已高于上轮周期同期的 1.03。这种跨周期对比证实，当前市场的估值底比 2022 年更为坚实，筹码结构未进一步恶化。底部具备强支撑。偏多。周期拐点还有多远？
title_en: 🔥Valuation floor is stronger than the last cycle
body_en: The market is in a historical bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.26. While still low—lower than 77% of historical readings—it’s already above the 1.03 from the same stage of the last cycle. This cross-cycle comparison confirms that the current valuation floor is more solid than in 2022, and the supply structure hasn't deteriorated further. Strong support at the bottom. Leaning bullish. How far are we from the cycle inflection point?
